title: NASA smashed into an asteroid. Now Hera is closing in to see what happened
caption:
Europe’s Hera spacecraft is officially approaching the Didymos-Dimorphos system. It’s here to investigate why NASA’s 2022 impact test moved the asteroid so much further than scientists initially predicted.

Source: Sciencedaily - NASA smashed into an asteroid. Now Hera is closing in to see what happened
